ratios.quote: The minimum required consolidated interest coverage ratio is 3.00 to 1.00 throughout the term of the amended credit agreement.

parsed.notes: The filing gives no actual ratio values. It says only that the company was in compliance with all debt covenants as of September 30, 2026. Both leverage ratios are calculated net of unrestricted cash above $15.0 million, so they are classified as net measures. The maximum leverage ratios step down later: total leverage 4.25x and secured leverage 3.50x from Q3 2027 to Q4 2027, then 4.00x and 3.25x from March 31, 2028 onward. The interest rate margin based on the leverage ratio is excluded.
